blocks.text: As World EV Day puts electric vehicles (EVs) in the spotlight, Pioneer Insurance is reminding Filipinos that EV ownership comes with unique considerations. With the right coverage in place, motorists can embrace the EV experience with greater confidence and be better prepared for the road ahead. Amid rising fuel prices, the idea of plugging in instead of filling up has become increasingly compelling. In fact, the country’s EV ecosystem continues to expand, with 472 recognized EV models, 258 accredited charging-station providers, and 1,569 charging points nationwide, as reported by the Department of Energy as of March 2026.
